about: The r3x round-2 showcase film v135-stop-metres (run 40569421125, req r-r3x2sh-0001, 2026-10-27/28, stopped at the film gate at 7/12 twice, never voiced) replayed: the panel of 2026-10-28 named its faults.

pitches.logline: A young man driving home late on a Tbilisi avenue keeps speeding up and sees what each extra km/h adds to his stop: 14 m at 50, 56 m at 100, then a child steps out 40 m ahead.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: brakes squeal, a metre counter over the night avenue reads 14 m and rolls to 56 m as the speed jumps from 50 to 100.

pitches.logline: Every driver guesses that 100 needs twice the room of 50; the counter shows the guess, strikes it and rolls on to the real 56 m, then the lesson explains why on the same avenue.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the counter shows the guess over the night avenue, a brake squeal hits and the guess is struck while the counter rolls to 56 m.

pitches.logline: A made-up neighbour mocks me for crawling along the avenue at 50 and races off at 100; when a child steps out 40 m ahead, my stop needs only 14 m while his needs 56.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: a horn blares beside me at the light, the neighbour's put-down lands, and the metre counter starts counting the stop as the speed climbs.

treatment.logline: A made-up neighbour mocks me for crawling along the avenue at 50 and races off at 100; when a child steps out 40 m ahead, my stop needs only 14 m while his needs 56.
treatment.hero: me, a calm driver at 50 on one Tbilisi avenue at night (heard, never drawn), against a made-up neighbour at 100
treatment.obstacle: everyone thinks twice the speed needs twice the room to stop; it needs four times

hook.event: a horn blares at the light and the neighbour calls me a coward for doing 50, while the stop's metres count up as the speed climbs

act1: the horn and the put-down at the light, quiet and grey
he races off at 100 while I stay at 50: his stop runs past mine on the scale
his stop reaches 56 m, four times my 14 (Queensland government table, dry road)
a child steps out 40 m ahead on the avenue: my stop fits inside it, his reaction alone eats 42 m
treatment.turn: the hold and the drop: „არაუშავს!“ slammed on a hard cut, then the stop counted out loud

reveal.what: he races off at 100 while I stay at 50, then the two stops on one metre scale, the card 14 against 56 and the blocks stacking

treatment.payoff: the same me at the same light: still the coward, but I stop in time, and now the neighbour drives like me
treatment.signature: two stops on one metre scale, mine landing under the dashed 40 m line while his runs on past it
